$comment: The chain of command for this repository. Ratified by the Owner 2026-11-02. CI reads this file (tools/check_authority.py, tools/check_downhill.py); agents read it before acting on a conflict. Lower tier number = higher authority.

owns: deciding conflicts no higher tier resolves
everything: wins any conflict with any other file in this repository
the frame: P, M, X and F lines; what the system must and must not do (Mandate)
roles as binding behaviour for program delegates, states, schemas, the pass rule
the job form: Entry A and B, rules 1-12, I1-I24
field names; requiredness only where stricter than the Contracts (schemas)
expected verdicts, which win over EDI-EXAMPLE.md (fixtures)
reading order and hard bans (For Machines); teaching and illustration only (Quickstart, Example)

lateral.name: custody/v1
lateral.governs: the retained record's own fields and terms
lateral.note: Not a rank. DOCTRINE.md defers to it (the doctrine never redefines the record's terms), so it never conflicts with tier 1.

conflict_rule: A higher tier wins. The file on the lower tier is the defect, and it is fixed there; a higher tier is never edited to match a lower one.

Same tier: first test the disagreement against every higher tier, nearest first, up to DOCTRINE.md. The first tier that answers the question, directly or by clear entailment, decides it, and the same-tier file that disagrees with it is the defect.

If no higher tier answers it, escalate to the Owner (tier 0) as needs_owner, with the two conflicting passages, each higher-tier file checked and why it did not settle the question, and a recommendation.
Within a tier, each domain has one owner file (domains above).
